en.headline: Observatory issues yellow fire danger warning as risk remains high
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the yellow fire danger warning at 9:45am on Saturday, urging the public to prevent fires and hikers to stay vigilant.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a yellow fire danger warning at 9:45am on Saturday, stating that the fire risk is high.
The Observatory said the fire danger situation today is yellow. People are urged to prevent fires from breaking out, and hikers should also be vigilant.
The warning remains in force as of the latest check. No other weather warnings were reported in force at that time.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色火災危險警告 指火險頗高
zh.dek: 天文台今日上午9時45分發出黃色火災危險警告，呼籲市民防止火災發生，遠足人士亦須提高警覺。
body: 香港天文台於今日上午9時45分發出黃色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性頗高。
天文台指出，今日火災危險情況為黃色。市民應防止火災發生，遠足人士亦須提高警覺。
警告現時仍然生效。截至最新查核，未有其他天氣警告生效。
